1000.name: At The Base of The White Marble Stairs

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

up.description: To the up lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

1000.description:
The valley road ends at a broad marble landing where the White Marble
Stairs begin their long climb. Pale steps rise overhead into a shaft of
cold light, each one worn hollow in the middle by ages of divine feet.
Tall columns frame the opening onto the valley, and the way back runs
west to the valley floor. Thunder rolls somewhere high above, and the
air smells faintly of honey.

1001.name: Climbing The White Marble Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies At The Base of The White Marble Stairs.

1001.description:
The White Marble Stairs climb steeply inside a vaulted shaft, each step
as wide as a wagon and polished smooth by countless feet. Pale light
seeps from somewhere overhead, and the walls sweat with a cool mist.
Looking back down the flight you can still see the landing, small and
bright.

1002.name: Climbing The White Marble Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

1002.description:
Halfway into the climb the steps grow cold and the air thins. Carved
laurel wreaths run along the walls, each leaf cut so finely that it
seems to stir in the draught. The marble underfoot is veined with grey,
like clouds trapped in stone.

1003.name: Climbing The White Marble Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

1003.description:
The stair narrows here, and slits in the wall let in the roar of wind
from outside. Each step is chipped at the edge, as if some huge weight
once climbed it in haste. A smell of rain and hot metal drifts down from
above. The steps seem endless, yet the light ahead grows steadily
brighter.

1004.name: Climbing The White Marble Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

1004.description:
The stairs end at a wide landing beneath a doorway of gold-veined stone,
its heavy lintel carved with a spiral of winding paths. Beyond the arch
the air feels dry and charged, as before a storm. The last steps are
worn nearly flat. Muffled thunder comes from within, as steady as a
heartbeat.

1005.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

down.description: To the down lies Climbing The White Marble Stairs.

south.description: To the south lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1005.description:
The Labyrinth begins as a low hall of white marble, cut by narrow
turnings that seem to double back on themselves. A mosaic spiral covers
the floor, its tesserae gold and bone. Cold lamplight burns without
flame in niches along the walls. The air is dry and still, and your
footsteps return from places they should not reach.

1006.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

south.description: To the south lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1006.description:
Walls of marble streaked with black rise to a ceiling lost in gloom, and
every passage ends in another identical archway. Bronze rings hang from
the stonework at head height, rusted shut. Scratches at the foot of one
wall form a tally of days kept by someone long gone. A faint draught
smells of oil and old blood.

1007.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

east.description: To the east lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1007.description:
A round chamber opens off the winding ways, its domed ceiling painted
with stars that have mostly flaked away. In the centre stands a dry
basin of green marble, cracked and empty. Six archways ring the room,
and each looks exactly like the others. The silence is thick enough to
press on the ears.

1008.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

west.description: To the west lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

east.description: To the east lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1008.description:
The passage is so narrow here that your shoulders brush the cold walls.
Carved friezes run along both sides, showing a bull-headed figure hunted
through a maze by heroes with bronze spears. The carvings are chipped at
the faces, as though someone hated what they showed. Water drips
somewhere ahead with a slow, patient rhythm.

1009.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

west.description: To the west lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

east.description: To the east lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1009.description:
Broken columns lie across the floor of this hall like felled trees,
forcing a crooked path through the rubble. The ceiling has fallen in
places, and heaps of white dust glitter on the tiles. Great cloven
hoofprints are pressed into the dust, then scuffed half away. A smell of
musk and wet straw lingers in the stale air.

1010.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

west.description: To the west lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

north.description: To the north lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1010.description:
A long gallery lined with mirrors of polished silver stretches ahead,
each sheet warped and clouded with tarnish. Your reflection stretches
and bends as you pass, sometimes with one arm too many. The floor is
laid in black and white squares like a game board. A sweet, heavy scent
of incense hangs in the air.

1011.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

south.description: To the south lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

north.description: To the north lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1011.description:
This hall is a dead row of sealed doors, dozens of them set into the
marble, each with a bronze handle shaped like a lion's head. None opens
when tried, and the corridor between them twists on. Torches in iron
brackets have burned down to black stubs. Cold air creeps from the
cracks around the doors.

1012.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

south.description: To the south lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

north.description: To the north lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1012.description:
The floor tilts gently here, and the walls curve with it, giving the odd
sense of walking round the inside of a giant shell. Seashells set into
the marble in neat spirals glitter in the dim light. A green stain of
sea-damp runs down the stone, though no sea lies within a hundred
leagues. Distant thunder shakes loose a thin rain of dust.

1013.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

south.description: To the south lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

north.description: To the north lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

west.description: To the west lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1013.description:
Statues of tired heroes line this hall, each carved with an expression
of despair, as if they too had lost their way. Their stone hands are
held out palms upward, and some have been snapped off at the wrist. A
thread of gold wire, long tangled and dull, still trails across the
floor. A sound like slow breathing seems to come from the walls.

1014.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

south.description: To the south lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1014.description:
This last coil of the Labyrinth ends at a tall arch of white marble
framing a bright street beyond. The walls are smoother here, their
carving fresh and sharp, and the air smells of open sky. A path of pale
flagstones leads north out of the maze. Behind you the passages turn
dark and secretive again.

1015.name: Walking the White Marble Streets

north.description: To the north lies Walking The White Marble Streets.

south.description: To the south lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1015.description:
A broad avenue of polished white marble leaves the mouth of the
Labyrinth, shining like a frozen river under the storm light. To the
south the arched maze entrance opens in a wall of stone, and to the
north the street runs on toward a plaza. Slender pillars topped with
carved garlands flank the avenue. Thunder rolls over the rooftops, and
the scent of ambrosia hangs in the wind.

1016.name: Walking The White Marble Streets

east.description: To the east lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

south.description: To the south lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

west.description: To the west lies Inside a Demigod's Abode.

1016.description:
The street meets a quiet plaza where a dry fountain stands, its marble
dolphins worn to blank stumps. To the west a low doorway of green stone
leads into a demigod's abode, while the avenue runs east between empty
colonnades and south back toward the maze. Gilded weather vanes creak on
the rooftops. Olive leaves drift across the paving.

extra_descs.fountain dolphins:
The fountain basin is bone dry, and the four marble dolphins at its
centre have been worn by wind and rain until they look like sleeping
fists.

1018.name: Inside a Demigod's Abode

east.description: To the east lies Walking The White Marble Streets.

1018.description:
This demigod's lodging is a low, dim hall of green-black stone, its
walls hung with the rotted remnants of tapestries. A great round shield
of bronze, dented and green, is fixed above the fireplace. A broad bed
of stone stands along one wall with a pillow carved of marble. The only
way out leads east to the plaza. The air is stale and chilly.

1019.name: Walking the White Marble Streets

north.description: To the north lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

west.description: To the west lies Walking The White Marble Streets.

1019.description:
The street bends between tall white walls inlaid with bands of lapis
blue. Statues of stern heroes stand in wall niches, most of them missing
hands or heads. The street runs north toward a wider square and west
back toward the plaza. A warm wind carries the smell of laurel smoke.

1020.name: Walking the White Marble Streets

north.description: To the north lies Entrance to the Gods' Cathedral.

east.description: To the east lies Inside a Demigod's Abode.

south.description: To the south lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

west.description: To the west lies Inside an Angel's House.

1020.description:
A wide square lies before the great cathedral, ringed with cypresses in
marble planters. A white house carved with feathers stands to the west,
a demigod's abode opens to the east, and the street runs south, while
the cathedral's golden doors rise to the north. The paving is inlaid
with a pattern of rays, like a sun carved into the stone. Lightning
glints off the high gilded roofs.

1021.name: Inside a Demigod's Abode

west.description: To the west lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

1021.description:
This demigod's abode is a spacious hall of cream-coloured stone with a
cracked marble hearth, a curved couch carved from a single block and
wall niches empty of trophies. Faded frescoes of hunts and games cover
the walls. The doorway opens west onto the square. A fine layer of dust
lies on everything, and the room smells of cold ash.

1022.name: Inside an Angel's House

east.description: To the east lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

1022.description:
The angel's house is a small round chamber of luminous white stone, its
domed ceiling carved with slender feathers that overlap like a wing. A
bare perch is set into the wall beside a basin of clear stone. The door
opens east to the square. Everything is hushed, and the light seems to
come from the stone itself.

1023.name: Entrance to the Gods' Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies Inside The Gods Cathedral.

south.description: To the south lies Walking the White Marble Streets.

1023.description:
The doorway of the Gods' Cathedral is a deep arch lined with rows of
carved winged figures, their faces turned toward the street. Inside the
entrance a vestibule of cool marble lies hushed beneath a high vaulted
roof. Bronze lamps hang from chains, all long unlit. The way south leads
back to the square, and the nave opens to the north.

1024.name: Inside The Gods Cathedral

south.description: To the south lies Entrance to the Gods' Cathedral.

up.description: To the up lies On Top of The Gods Table.

1024.description:
The nave of the Gods' Cathedral is vast, a hall of pillars so tall that
their capitals vanish in a haze of cloud-coloured light. Rows of empty
benches face a great flight of white steps. At the top of the steps the
Gods' Table spreads like a stone plateau, bare and silent. The vestibule
lies south of here, and the echoes of your own steps return like distant
applause.

1025.name: On Top of The Gods Table

east.description: To the east lies Upon Hermes Throne.

down.description: To the down lies Inside The Gods Cathedral.

1025.description:
You stand atop the Gods' Table itself, a slab of white marble as broad
as a meadow and open to a thunder-filled sky. Here the Olympians once
feasted, and the places along its rim are still marked by carved cups
the size of cauldrons. Steps lead down into the cathedral below, and a
winged throne stands to the east. The wind smells of ambrosia and
scorched air.

extra_descs.cups table rim:
The carved cups along the rim of the Table are each large enough to
bathe in. Deep inside every one lies a faint gold stain, the last of the
nectar.

1026.name: Upon Hermes Throne

north.description: To the north lies Upon Apollo's Throne.

west.description: To the west lies On Top of The Gods Table.

1026.description:
The throne of Hermes is a light seat of white marble, its arms carved
like wings swept back for flight. Stone sandals are set into the plinth
at its foot. The Table stretches west toward the great stairs, and a
path runs north along its rim toward another throne. Wind tugs at your
clothes, and lightning flashes along the horizon.

1027.name: Upon Apollo's Throne

south.description: To the south lies Upon Hermes Throne.

west.description: To the west lies Crossing the Gods' Table.

1027.description:
Apollo's throne is a high seat of white marble fronted by a great
sunburst of beaten gold, dulled now by weather. The strings of a lyre
are carved along the armrests, one of them cracked clean through. The
path leads back south to the throne of Hermes and west along the Table
into a roofed stretch. The light has a warm, honeyed quality here, even
beneath the storm.

1028.name: Crossing the Gods' Table

west.description: To the west lies Upon Aphrodite's Throne.

east.description: To the east lies Upon Apollo's Throne.

1028.description:
A roofed stretch of the Gods' Table passes through a gallery of rose-
coloured columns, its ceiling painted with pale doves. The table runs on
west toward a throne of pink stone. Carved bowls line its surface, each
rimmed with dried gold. The air is warm, perfumed and strangely close.

1029.name: Upon Aphrodite's Throne

north.description: To the north lies Upon Artemis's Throne.

east.description: To the east lies Crossing the Gods' Table.

1029.description:
Aphrodite's throne is a shell of pink-veined marble, its curved back
carved with roses and doves. Stone petals lie scattered in drifts around
the seat. The table turns north toward another throne. A heady fragrance
of rose and myrrh clings to the stone, sweet beneath the sharper tang of
ozone.

1030.name: Upon Artemis's Throne

east.description: To the east lies Crossing The Gods' Table.

south.description: To the south lies Upon Aphrodite's Throne.

1030.description:
Artemis's throne is a seat of pale silver-white stone, its back shaped
like a crescent moon. A frieze of running hounds and arrows wraps the
plinth. The table runs east from here along a line of low pillars. A
cold, clean wind sighs among the pillars, smelling of pine and rain.

1031.name: Crossing The Gods' Table

east.description: To the east lies Upon Dionysus's Throne.

west.description: To the west lies Upon Artemis's Throne.

1031.description:
The Gods' Table narrows here to a stately ribbon of marble, wide enough
for six to walk abreast. Its surface is scored with the long-dried
stains of spilled wine. The way runs east toward a throne draped in
carved ivy. Thunder cracks overhead, and a few fat drops of rain strike
the stone.

1032.name: Upon Dionysus's Throne

north.description: To the north lies Upon Hephaestus's Throne.

west.description: To the west lies Crossing The Gods' Table.

1032.description:
Dionysus's throne is a tangle of carved vines in dark green marble, with
grapes the size of fists hanging from its arms. Wine-dark stains seep
into the plinth and never quite dry. The table turns north from this
seat. The air smells of crushed grapes and the sweet sourness of ancient
feasts.

1033.name: Upon Hephaestus's Throne

west.description: To the west lies Crossing the Gods' Table.

south.description: To the south lies Upon Dionysus's Throne.

1033.description:
Hephaestus's throne is forged rather than carved, a seat of black iron
and bronze set into the marble with a great anvil for its back. Soot
stains the stone around it, and a rack of stone tongs and hammers is
fixed to the plinth. The table runs west into a roofed gallery. A faint
warmth rises from the metal, as if a forge still burned somewhere
beneath.

1034.name: Crossing the Gods' Table

west.description: To the west lies Before Athena's Throne.

east.description: To the east lies Upon Hephaestus's Throne.

1034.description:
Here the Gods' Table passes inside a pillared hall of grey-veined stone,
its ceiling hung with carved owls and olive branches. Marble cups the
size of buckets line the board. The table leads west toward a throne of
pale stone. The hall is cool and quiet, and the thunder is only a
murmur.

1035.name: Before Athena's Throne

north.description: To the north lies Upon Demeter's Throne.

east.description: To the east lies Crossing the Gods' Table.

1035.description:
Before Athena's throne stands a tall, helm-crowned seat of white marble,
its back wrought in the shape of a great shield. A carved owl perches on
the headrest, its eyes of dull glass staring. Spears and scrolls are cut
into the plinth in careful order. The table turns north from here, and
the room smells of wax, ink and old bronze.

1036.name: Upon Demeter's Throne

east.description: To the east lies Crossing the Gods' Table.

south.description: To the south lies Before Athena's Throne.

1036.description:
Demeter's throne is woven from carved wheat in golden stone, with
sheaves bending along the backrest. Dry husks and petals lie in drifts
across the floor, though nothing grows here. The table runs east from
the seat. The air is thick with the ghost of warm bread and dry earth.

1037.name: Crossing the Gods' Table

east.description: To the east lies Upon Ares' Throne.

west.description: To the west lies Upon Demeter's Throne.

1037.description:
A low arcade lined with iron torch-brackets crosses this stretch of the
table, its floor scuffed by heavy boots. Spear racks of marble stand
against the wall, empty. The table runs east toward a seat of dark red
stone. A metallic smell hangs in the air, and the stone feels oddly
warm.

1038.name: Upon Ares' Throne

north.description: To the north lies Upon Poseidon's Throne.

west.description: To the west lies Crossing the Gods' Table.

1038.description:
Ares' throne is a brutal seat of red-black stone, its arms carved as
clenched fists and its back set with a hundred stone spearheads. Great
gouges mark the floor, as if blades had been dragged across it in anger.
The table turns north from here. A smell of iron and sweat lingers, and
the silence seems to wait for a fight.

1039.name: Upon Poseidon's Throne

west.description: To the west lies At the Head of The Gods' Table.

south.description: To the south lies Upon Ares' Throne.

1039.description:
Poseidon's throne rises like a wave frozen at its crest, carved from
blue-green marble with a trident-shaped crack through its back. The
floor around it is damp, though no water seeps in. The table runs west
toward the head of the feast. Briny air, sea-cold and sharp, hangs in
the hall.

1040.name: At the Head of The Gods' Table

north.description: To the north lies Upon Zeus's Mighty Throne.

west.description: To the west lies Upon Hera's Throne.

east.description: To the east lies Upon Poseidon's Throne.

1040.description:
The Gods' Table ends in a wide hall at its head, where the greatest
seats face the length of the feast. A broad arch leads north to the
throne of the king of the gods, and a smaller one opens west to his
queen's seat. The ceiling is lost in shadow, and the floor is inlaid
with a pattern of lightning in gold. Every footstep rings.

1041.name: Upon Hera's Throne

east.description: To the east lies At the Head of The Gods' Table.

1041.description:
Hera's throne is a seat of ivory-white marble crowned with a carved
diadem of peacock feathers. Fine drapes of stone fall from its canopy,
cut with such skill that they seem to move. The only way out is back
east to the head of the Table. The room is cold and formal, and the
faint scent of lilies lingers.

1042.name: Upon Zeus's Mighty Throne

north.description: To the north lies The Tomb of Kronos, Lord of the Titans.

south.description: To the south lies At the Head of The Gods' Table.

1042.description:
Zeus's mighty throne towers over the hall, a seat of white marble twice
the height of a man, its arms carved as eagles' wings. Blackened scars
run across the steps where lightning once struck and gathered. A narrow
doorway of dark stone opens north behind the seat into a place of old
silence. The air tingles, and the hairs on your neck rise.

extra_descs.scars steps lightning:
The scars on the steps are fused glass, black and glossy, shaped like
branching rivers. They are still faintly warm.

1043.name: The Tomb of Kronos, Lord of the Titans

south.description: To the south lies Upon Zeus's Mighty Throne.

1043.description:
The tomb is a low vault of black stone, cold as a winter well, where the
titan lord was bound after the war. Great chains as thick as a man's
body run from the walls to a ring set in the floor. The air smells of
damp earth and iron, and a slow pulse seems to beat in the rock. Faded
runes cover the walls in rings, each one cut deeper than the last.

extra_descs.chains ring runes:
The chains are forged from a dull grey metal that sheds frost when
touched. The runes spiral inward toward the ring, repeating a single
word of binding.

1044.name: Entering the Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1044.description:
The old road climbs out of the foothills here and passes between two
weathered marble pillars into the Great Valley. Back to the north the
road runs open and clear down toward the Great Forest of MiNar, whose
dark canopy shows faintly through the haze. South of the pillars the
valley lies spread out, pale and enormous beneath a bruised sky. A
carved lintel across the pillars is cracked by frost.

extra_descs.pillars pillar lintel:
Two marble pillars stand at the valley mouth, joined by a lintel carved
with a procession of robed figures. Frost has split the lintel, and the
figures have lost their faces.

1045.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Entering the Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1045.description:
The valley opens wide here, ringed by cliffs of gleaming white rock that
catch every flicker of the storm. The road runs north toward the
valley's mouth and south deeper into the high basin. Broken paving
stones show where a grander avenue once ran, and a lone cypress leans
over the verge.

1046.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1046.description:
Pale dust lies deep on the valley road, rutted by the wheels of chariots
from some forgotten procession. The road runs north toward the valley's
mouth and south to a junction of paths, while a narrow track bends west
into a small side hollow. Poppies grow thick in the ditches, startlingly
red against the white stone.

1047.name: Traversing The Great Valley

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1047.description:
A small hollow opens off the valley road, floored with cracked mosaic
tiles whose pictures have faded to ghosts of blue and gold. A dry
fountain basin sits in the middle with a stone spout worn smooth. The
only way out is back east to the road. The wind makes a low humming
among the broken tiles.

1048.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1048.description:
Three paths meet where a stream once ran, its bed now a ribbon of white
pebbles. To the north the way climbs gently toward the valley mouth, to
the east it follows a rocky shelf, and to the south it drops toward a
roofed crossing of tall pillars. A thin keening cry echoes off the
cliffs and dies away.

1049.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1049.description:
Four marble porticoes meet beneath a single great domed roof held up by
a ring of fluted columns. Daylight falls through a round opening in the
dome onto a star inlaid in gold and black stone. Archways lead north
toward the pebbly stream bed, east into a small court, south along a
colonnade and west to a steep track. Faint thunder shakes dust from the
cornice.

1050.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1050.description:
A long shelf of bare rock carries the path, with a fall of loose scree
on one hand and the mountain wall on the other. Lightning-scarred pines
cling to cracks in the stone. The path runs north to a patch of thyme
and west toward a larger meeting of ways. A line of weathered marble
milestones, carved with letters no one reads now, marks the edge of the
drop.

extra_descs.milestones milestone letters:
Each milestone carries a column of letters in an ancient script, rubbed
nearly smooth by wind. A few still show a single repeated sign, a bolt
of lightning.

1051.name: Traversing The Great Valley

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1051.description:
Banks of wild thyme grow between toppled columns here, and the heat hums
with bees. The path leads east toward a crossing and turns south down a
gentle slope of loose stone. High above, the peak is hidden in a crown
of storm cloud lit from within by pale flashes.

1052.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1052.description:
Three ways cross in the long shadow of the mountain, where scree and
pale grass crowd the broken paving. The path runs north toward the foot
of the great stairs, south into a hollow of the valley, and west along
the slope. A shattered plinth stands in the middle of the crossing, its
figure long gone.

extra_descs.plinth pedestal:
The plinth is a block of white marble taller than a man. Only a pair of
carved stone feet remains on top, as if the god it held simply stepped
away.

1053.name: Traversing The Great Valley

east.description: To the east lies At The Base of The White Marble Stairs.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1053.description:
The valley floor is paved here with cracked white flags, and the great
stairs stand close by to the east, pale against the mountain. Wind
carries a hint of ambrosia down from the heights. The path bends south
along a dry watercourse filled with fallen marble blocks. Thunder
mutters from clouds that never quite leave the peaks.

1054.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1054.description:
The valley narrows into a blind hollow walled by sheer grey rock
streaked with white veins of marble. Nothing grows here but wiry
thistles, and the only way out is the path back north. An old altar
slab, split down the middle by lightning, lies half buried in the
gravel. The air is still and warm and tastes of dust and honey.

1055.name: Traversing The Great Valley

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1055.description:
A small walled court lies off the pillared crossing, paved in squares of
rose and white marble and overgrown with creeping vines. A stone bench
faces a mural of cloud-borne chariots, flaking away in great patches.
The only way out is back west under the domed roof. The scent of old
ambrosia hangs in the still air, thick and sweet.

1056.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1056.description:
A colonnade runs along the foot of the cliff, its columns leaning at odd
angles from the tremors of ages. To the north it ends at the domed
crossing, to the east a stony path winds off along the valley floor, and
to the south the colonnade falls away into a narrow gully. Grey cloud
slides across the peaks. A fallen capital carved with acanthus leaves
lies in the way.

1057.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1057.description:
A steep track begins at the edge of the domed crossing, with rough steps
cut into the living rock. It climbs north up the slope, while the
pillared roof lies back to the east. Wild rosemary spills over the edges
of the steps. Scorch marks on the rock tell of lightning strikes that
fell here long ago.

1058.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1058.description:
The gully is choked with fallen marble, huge white blocks wedged between
the cliff walls like the pieces of a dropped toy. Ferns grow in the damp
shade between them. The only path leads back north to the colonnade.
Somewhere inside the heap a draught whistles through a hollow.

1059.name: Traversing The Great Valley

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1059.description:
The path squeezes between two shoulders of pale rock that gleam like wet
bone. Water seeps down the cliff and gathers in a clear pool beside the
track. West lies the leaning colonnade, and east the path continues past
a spill of boulders. Thunder echoes in the narrow place like a drum.

1060.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1060.description:
A bend in the valley wall opens a wider view of the high basin, with
silver threads of waterfall far off on the cliffs. The path turns north
up a stony rise and west back toward the pool. Brittle grass hisses in
the wind, and small blue flowers grow where the stones stay damp.

1061.name: Traversing The Great Valley

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1061.description:
The path ends on a small windy terrace overlooking the whole sweep of
the valley. A ring of low marble posts, once linked by chains, marks
where pilgrims used to rest and pray. Heat shimmers on the stones, and
the place feels watched from above. The only way back is south down the
stony rise.

1062.name: Traversing The Great Valley

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1062.description:
The ridge track levels onto a broad bench of rock with a clear view over
the pale valley floor. South the track drops back to the pillared
crossing, and west it goes on through a notch in the stone. Gnarled
junipers grow from the cracks, twisted by the winds. A cairn of white
stones stands at the edge, built by some forgotten traveller.

1063.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

east.description: To the east lies Traversing The Great Valley.

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1063.description:
The track forks in a bowl of tumbled rock, with a flat boulder carved
with a fading spiral in the middle of the junction. A gentler path runs
on north, a rough way winds down to the south, and the bench above the
valley lies back east. The air here is cooler and smells of wet stone
and sage.

1064.name: Traversing The Great Valley

south.description: To the south lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1064.description:
A narrow shelf of rock hangs over a long drop, ending at a ledge where
the wind is fierce enough to push at your cloak. Far below, the valley
floor is a pattern of paler and darker stone, split by the old stream
bed. The only way out is the path back south. Lightning flickers in the
cloud at eye level, and the hair on your arms rises.

1065.name: Traversing The Great Valley

north.description: To the north lies Traversing The Great Valley.

1065.description:
A cleft in the rock holds a shrine no bigger than a cupboard, its marble
god long since carried off or broken. Dry laurel leaves lie heaped in
the alcove. The only way back leads north to the fork in the track. Wind
whispers in the cleft with something very like a voice.

extra_descs.shrine alcove laurel:
The alcove is empty but for a worn footprint in the stone where the
god's statue once stood. Someone has left fresh-looking laurel leaves in
a ring around it.

1099.name: The Gods' Labyrinth

east.description: To the east lies The Gods' Labyrinth.

1099.description:
A hidden chamber stands apart from the winding ways, its walls thick
with soot and its floor strewn with shards of broken pottery. A great
altar of black stone fills one end, grooved with channels for offerings.
Faded paintings on the wall show a king feeding youths into the maze.
The air is heavy with the cold of a place where hope was lost.

643900.name: harpy winged hag
643900.long_desc: A bronze-clawed harpy circles overhead, shrieking and eyeing you hungrily.
643900.description:
She has the body of a vulture and the withered face of an old woman,
with talons that glint like new bronze. Her feathers are stained with
soot and the gold dust of the empty high places.

643901.name: lion golden maned
643901.long_desc: A golden-maned lion paces the stones, its hide shimmering like beaten metal.
643901.description:
A lion of the old mountain kind, huge and tawny, its mane shining as
though dusted with gold. Its claws leave grooves in the white stone as
it walks.

643902.name: marble guard sentinel statue
643902.long_desc: A living marble guard stands rigid at its post, spear leveled at the unwary.
643902.description:
A towering warrior carved of white stone, with blank eyes and a
hoplite's crest. It moves with a grinding slowness, but each swing of
its spear lands like a falling column.

643903.name: minotaur bull beast
643903.long_desc: A snorting minotaur stalks the passages, its horns scraping the marble walls.
643903.description:
A hulking man with the head of a bull, slick with sweat and wild with
rage. Its horns are chipped from a thousand blows against stone, and its
breath steams in the cold.

643904.name: chimera lion goat serpent
643904.long_desc: A storm chimera prowls the white streets, a snake-tail lashing behind it.
643904.description:
A beast of three bodies, with a lion's head, a goat's head along its
spine and a serpent for a tail. Sparks crackle along its mane, and it
smells of burnt hair.

643905.name: gorgon snake-haired stone
643905.long_desc: A snake-haired gorgon lurks in the dim passages, her hissing locks writhing.
643905.description:
A lean, scaled woman whose hair is a mass of living snakes. Fragments of
statues lie in the dust around her feet, still frozen in the shape of
fear.

643906.name: talos bronze guardian giant
643906.short_desc: Talos, Bronze Guardian of the Thrones
643906.long_desc: Talos, Bronze Guardian of the Thrones, stands in the arch, his bronze limbs glowing with inner heat.
643906.description:
A giant of living bronze, his single vein running with molten gold
behind a nail at his ankle. He turns his helmed head slowly toward you,
and the whole hall rings with each step he takes.

643907.name: hyperion titan chained
643907.long_desc: Hyperion, the Chained Titan, strains against his bonds, his eyes blazing like twin suns.
643907.description:
A titan of the elder race, so tall that his head brushes the vault of
the tomb. Great chains bind his limbs, yet he drags against them, and
the stone trembles with every pull.

743900.name: cloak feather harpy
743900.room_desc: A cloak of dark harpy feathers lies here.
743900.description: Dark, glossy feathers are sewn in overlapping rows onto a light grey cloth. It rustles in even a faint breeze.

743901.name: aegis shield marble round
743901.room_desc: A round shield faced with white marble lies here.
743901.description: A round bronze shield faced with a thin slab of white marble. A snarling face is carved at its centre.

743902.name: labrys axe double bronze
743902.room_desc: A double-bladed bronze labrys lies here.
743902.description: A heavy axe with a crescent blade on either side of its haft. Maze patterns are etched along the bronze.

743903.name: greaves bronze talos
743903.room_desc: A pair of bronze greaves lies here, warm to the touch.
743903.description: Greaves of golden bronze that stay faintly warm. Fine channels run through the metal like veins.

743904.name: maul titan sundering hammer
743904.short_desc: the Sundering Maul of the titans
743904.room_desc: An enormous stone maul lies here, rimmed with frost.
743904.description: A maul with a head of black stone, cold enough to numb the hand, and a haft bound in links of broken chain. It was made for a hand far larger than yours.
